name: oppo-coloros14-recommended
description: Recommended-rated OEM and partner packages that were uninstalled for user 0 on an OPPO A3x 5G (CPH2681, ColorOS 14.0.1, Android 14) and stayed off while the phone was in daily use. Apply with: python tools/preset.py apply oppo-coloros14-recommended --device
